subject: MAP: Data handling & compliance milestone - draft / next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@healthco.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@healthco.com>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.inference, rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Data handling & compliance milestone - draft / next steps

Hi Sofia / Tom -

Thanks again for the call this morning. Attached is a v2 draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with the Data handling & compliance milestone filled out based on our discussion. Key items for that milestone are summarized below - please review and confirm so we can lock dates and responsibilities.

MAP milestone: Data handling & compliance (scope: HealthCo production + any PHI workflows)
- Target close date: 2026-08-15 (proposed)
- Redwood responsibilities:
  * Provide SOC 2 Type II report and relevant control narratives (attachment: Data_Handling_Summary).
  * Provide configuration details for encryption at rest (KMS integration), TLS in transit, and key rotation cadence.
  * Enable audit logging (API request/response metadata) and provide log retention options (default: 90 days; enterprise option: 1 year / 7 years for audit logs).
  * Support field-level redaction or PII/PHI masking patterns via config (no model fine-tuning on customer data unless explicitly agreed).
  * Coordinate Private/VPC deployment options if PHI is in scope (required for HIPAA/BAA).
- HealthCo responsibilities:
  * Confirm which data elements are considered PHI/PII and provide example payloads (redacted).
  * Confirm retention window requirement (ASC suggests 1 year for request logs; legal may request 7 years for audit archives).
  * Sign BAA (if PHI in scope) and provide legal contact for procurement/legal review.
  * Provide network/access details for Private deployment or staging test account.
- Dependencies:
  * Completed security questionnaire (we have a draft pending your Legal team).
  * BAA signed for PHI workloads.
  * SOC 2 report review and any additional attestation requests.
  * Test data / sample payloads from HealthCo to validate redaction rules.

Open questions from our side:
1) Can you confirm whether the initial scope includes PHI (e.g., protected health identifiers) or only limited PII?
2) Do you have a preferred retention window for API request/response logs and audit archives?
3) Will HealthCo require a Private/VPC deployment for production?

Next steps I propose:
- Sofia: confirm PHI/PII in-scope and preferred retention window by end of week (7/23).
- HealthCo legal: review & return BAA (we can provide standard BAA template).
- Redwood (Dev): prepare a short security pack (SOC 2, encryption, logging) and a kitted checklist for Private deployment.
- Schedule a 30-min technical follow-up w/ Dev and HealthCo infra to review access / test data (propose 7/27 or 7/28).

Attachment: MAP_HealthCo_v2.xlsx (MAP with milestone rows updated)
Attachment: Data_Handling_Summary_HealthCo.pdf (controls + log retention options)

Thanks - look forward to aligning.

- Marissa Cole
Senior Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0123

Hi Marissa -

Thanks for the summary and the MAP draft - looks great. A couple items to clarify from our side before we confirm dates:

- PHI scope: Yes, some workflows will include PHI (patient identifiers + treatment codes). We'll need a BAA and Private/VPC deployment for production.
- Retention: Our legal prefers a 7-year audit archive for compliance, but operational request logs can be 1 year if feasible.
- Redaction: We need field-level redaction for identifiers until the model response is returned; can you confirm if Redwood supports configurable redaction rules at the request pipeline level?

Also: our procurement person (Tom) will coordinate the BAA and procurement timeline - Tom, can you share the expected procurement window?

Happy to do the technical follow-up 7/27 morning PT.

Cheers,
Sofia
Director, Digital Platforms | HealthCo
sofia.alvarez@healthco.com

Sofia - great, thanks for confirming.

High-level responses:
- BAA / Private deployment: understood - we'll treat PHI as in-scope and route this to our Legal & Privacy teams. I'll loop legal for the BAA draft. Private/VPC deployment will be the recommended production posture; we'll include steps in the MAP to provision a staging VPC for validation.
- Retention: we can support two-tier retention: API operational logs (1 year) and immutable audit archives (configurable up to 7 years). I'll flag this as an item for Legal review since retention beyond 1 year can have implications for e-discovery.
- Redaction: Redwood supports configurable redaction patterns at request ingress (regex-based) and can also offer field-level masking in our Private deployment. We'll have Dev provide a short technical note on implementation patterns.

Action items (adding owners):
- Marissa: coordinate BAA with HealthCo Legal and provide BAA template (target 7/23).
- Dev Patel (cc): provide security pack + implementation note on redaction and audit logging; include sample retention config options and log export (target 7/24).
- Rishi Malhotra (cc): confirm deployment path (Hosted vs Private) and provide checklist for Private/VPC provisioning (target 7/24).

Tom - can you share procurement timeline/contacts so our legal and finance teams can coordinate?

I'll update the MAP and re-upload v3 once Dev's note is in.

Best,
Marissa

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.inference>

Subject: Re: MAP: Data handling & compliance milestone - draft / next steps

Hi all - quick dev note attached. Summary:
- Audit logging: we emit request metadata (timestamp, endpoint, client_id, request_id, response_status) and offer export to S3/Cloud Storage for longer-term retention. Default platform retention is 90 days; enterprise retention tiers: 1y (configurable) and 7y (archival export).
- Redaction: request-time regex redaction supported on Hosted for common patterns; field-level masking is available on Private deployments (deterministic masking and token removal). We do not use customer data for model training unless explicitly opted in under a controlled agreement.
- Encryption: AES-256 at rest + KMS integration (customer-managed keys available in Private). TLS 1.2+ in transit.
- Audit trails/access: CloudTrail-style audit events for admin actions in Private; role-based access controls and MFA required for admin console.

Dependencies we need from HealthCo:
- Example payloads with annotated PHI fields (redacted sample acceptable).
- Whitelist IPs or initial account to set up staging VPC access.

I've attached a 1-page "Data_Handling_Summary_HealthCo.pdf" and updated the MAP owners column. If you can share sample payloads and procurement contacts, I can prep a staging checklist and sample retention config by 7/24.

- Dev
